name: careerpilot-router
description: Route natural career planning, job, application, interview and offer requests. Use when the next step is unclear.

name: career-setup
description: Start job-change preparation, organize career facts and requirements. Use for 이직 준비 시작 or career setup.

name: career-strategy
description: Choose career direction and build a roadmap from evidence and original requirements.

name: opportunity-discovery
description: Find and screen target companies and roles as Core, Stretch or Strategic Entry.

name: job-intelligence
description: Analyze a job URL, JD text, PDF, screenshot or company and role. Use for 이 공고 어때 or job intelligence.

name: experience-mining
description: Extract truthful career evidence from conversation, supplied files or explicitly authorized available sources.

name: application-prep
description: Prepare truthful resumes, LinkedIn audit, portfolio decisions, cover letters, answers and recruiter drafts.

name: interview-prep
description: Prepare a scheduled or next-round interview, stories, questions and a compact cheat sheet.

name: mock-interview
description: Run a one-question-at-a-time mock interview with feedback only after explicit end, including English and pressure modes.

name: interview-debrief
description: Collect actual questions and answers first after 면접 끝났어, then revise next-round strategy and preserve records.

name: offer-decision
description: Evaluate actual offers against original requirements and prepare negotiation, reference and background-check decisions.

name: career-state
description: Export or restore a portable Career Context Pack and select company-specific context without mixing applications.
